ideas.topic: The Pharaoh Who Was Erased From History
ideas.hook: Archaeologists found his name chiseled out of stone, but why would an entire civilization try to delete a King?
ideas.why: It leverages the high-performing 'disgrace' and 'mystery' narrative pattern while maintaining historical accuracy regarding Hatshepsut or Akhenaten.

ideas.topic: 3 Ancient Egyptian Jobs You Wouldn't Survive
ideas.hook: Forget the Pharaohs; if you lived in Ancient Egypt, you’d likely end up in one of these three back-breaking professions.
ideas.why: It mirrors the viral 'unique jobs' listicle format, appealing to viewers' curiosity about the gritty, daily reality of ancient life.

ideas.topic: The Truth Behind the 'Curse' of the Pharaohs
ideas.hook: Did a deadly curse really kill the men who opened Tutankhamun’s tomb, or is the truth far more scientific?
ideas.why: It addresses a popular mythology topic with a 'fact-check' approach, satisfying the audience's interest in the supernatural while positioning your channel as the credible source.
